entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Asset: ONE modular BODY-ONLY armor sprite component for the BASTION melee class of Project RL. Supplied full-body character is reference for his massively muscular adult human anatomy, short thick neck, torso-to-limb proportions, planted wide frontal stance, silhouette scale and matte painted game-art style. We will attach ONE EXISTING IDENTICAL HEAD to every armor using a separate head layer. Therefore render the figure FROM THE TOP OF THE NECK DOWN TO THE BOOTS ONLY: absolutely NO head, face, beard, hair, implant, helmet or mask. The whole area above the natural base-of-skull neck attachment must be EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Leave a short normal human neck stump with a straight horizontal attachment edge at the top, no gore, no wound; this is a clean modular character sprite component, not an injury. The top of the neck stump is the highest opaque feature; shoulder armor must stay BELOW that line. Front orthographic view only. Preserve the powerful broad HUMAN build and the SAME stance, knees, two arms, two relaxed EMPTY hands positioned at upper thigh height, clearly separated legs and two complete planted boots. No extra limb, no weapon, no shield, no large backpack, no cape, no skirt, no apron, no tabard, no loincloth, no dangling straps. No magic, glow, holograms or new robotic body part. All equipment is for CLOSE-COMBAT impact protection and movement. Design an ENTIRE OUTFIT including torso, upper arms, forearms, gloves/hands, pelvis, trousers/thighs/knees/shins AND footwear; do NOT retain the original reference cargo trousers, original wrist wraps, original fingerless gloves or original boots as invariant items. These must match THIS outfit's protection level. Class identity comes from wide shoulders, thick human limbs, stance and a restrained shared palette: warm ivory, muted rust-orange accents, charcoal/olive underlayers, worn gunmetal. Not a different class, not a shooter or robe wearer. All materials matte and industrial, broad readable simple color/value areas, light from upper left, controlled dark silhouette, very few useful seams and broad wear areas, no dense rivets/circuitry or photographic grain. The final BODY module will be only 50 pixels tall below a fixed 8-9px head in a 64x64 game cell; prioritize distinct construction silhouettes at this tiny scale. Keep adult proportions, not chibi, not a towering mech. ONE centered complete neck-to-boots body module with ample genuine alpha-transparent margins, both feet fully inside canvas and on one baseline. No background, ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, labels, text or grid. This is a visual proposal only, no new game effects or numeric stats. SPECIFIC OUTFIT: Minimal impact protection: short warm-ivory sleeveless close-combat training vest in flexible reinforced cloth with narrow rusty-orange bindings, bare muscular upper arms, simple DARK soft wrist/forearm support wraps, lightweight fingerless fabric fighting gloves of a new simple cut (not the original black orange gloves), charcoal flexible work trousers with a clean slim cut and NO cargo pockets, small broad stitched knee patches, and short dark soft-soled ankle combat shoes with light tan toe caps. NO chest plate, shoulder plate, thigh plate or shin plate. This should be the least protected and most mobile-looking outfit of the five, still fully dressed from waist to ankles. Visible differences to the original on hands, pants and shoes.

entries.refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the supplied headless BODY MODULE for Project RL Bastion very-heavy melee armor BA-W01-P05. Make ONE narrowly scoped correction: the hands and ALL fingers must be FULLY COVERED by industrial ARMORED GLOVES. Replace every visible warm skin fingertip and thumb patch on BOTH hands with matte charcoal articulated finger plates, pale ivory fingertip/knuckle shells and dark joints; maintain five ordinary human-sized fingers on each hand. The final heaviest outfit must have more complete hand coverage than the heavy outfit. Preserve the same exact shape, pose and position of both hands and wrist anchors, large gauntlet volume and rust-orange knuckle latches. Do not turn the hands into claws or weapons. Everything else must stay as supplied: same headless body module with short clean neck stump and no head, no face or helmet; same ivory/rust-orange full-body armor, shoulder plates, chest, elbow guards, gauntlets, hip/thigh armor, knees, greaves and enormous squared armored boots; same sturdy adult human build, same frontal stance and whole neck-to-boots framing. No head may be added because a single shared head is attached separately. No new accessory, weapon, cape, effect or background. Same matte painted 2D game-art finish, upper-left light, clean genuine alpha transparency. One complete modular body only, both feet fully visible. No ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, labels or grid.
